column1: # How each registration or tax number is built (curated 2026-11-10 from the number survey,
# designs/company-generator-numbers.tsv, which has the structure, the check, worked examples and the
# sources of every row; labels, safe methods and sources are taken from there, not repeated here).
# builder: generic (pattern + check) or a builder named after the scheme, for numbers that encode
# the company (its form, region, year or name). pattern: # a digit, @ a capital letter, [..] a
# class, {n} or {m,n} a repeat, other characters literal; the check digit comes last and is not in
# the pattern. check: luhn, gtin, mod11_10 (ISO 7064 MOD 11,10), mod97_10 (ISO 7064), a named
# algorithm (the builder's), or weights:W...:RULE, where s = sum of digit x weight from the left,
# r = s mod 11 and RULE gives the digit (11-r, r, r%10, 10-r%10 ...) with exceptions "a=b" (a result
# a written b; "redraw": no number has it, draw another). groups: the legal-form groups holding the
# number (S sole proprietorship, P partnership, L limited liability, O other). params: the
# builder's settings; "anchors=" names a series read by read_anchors.py; TBD marks a code list or
# limit still to research (the builder then falls back to its pattern).
